what: a ruled loft between two 18-vertex zig-zag sections with the same start vertex and winding, whose first-vertex direction is ambiguous from the section centroid
method: vertex i of the bottom section is joined to vertex i of the top, so the solid is ruled and the section at height t is the polygon of the interpolated vertices; its area is quadratic in t, so Simpson is exact: V = h/6 (A0 + 4 Am + A1) with h = 90 and Am the shoelace area of the polygon of averaged vertices. Faces: 18 ruled sides + 2 planar caps.
